title: When the Scholarship Turns
premise: Dominic Vasquez has survived three years at elite Ashford Prep by staying invisible—until his anonymous coding forum account, built to expose the school's secret scholarship-slashing scheme, is traced back to him. When his best friend Marisol disappears the same night she discovers the truth, leaving behind a set of keys to the administration building, Dominic must choose between protecting himself and burning down the system that took her in. Racing through encrypted files, hostile trustees, and his own guilt, he finds Marisol hiding with evidence that could save every scholarship student—including him. In the end, Dominic testifies publicly, sacrificing his own scholarship and anonymity, but gains something rarer: a found family of students who refuse to disappear quietly.
about_author: Jude Galloway is a former scholarship kid who spent one year at a boarding school before trading it for a library card and a laptop. They write stories about kids who learn that silence is never free.

chapters.title: Head Down, Grades Up
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. We meet seventeen-year-old Dominic navigating Ashford Prep on a scholarship: perfect grades, zero friends beyond Marisol, and a secret anonymous account where he posts coded warnings about the school's finances. Emotional beat: the exhausting cost of invisibility, and the warmth of the one person who sees him.

chapters.title: The Keys She Left
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Marisol misses their study session; by midnight, police are at her foster home and her locker yields nothing but an old brass keyring labeled with the admin building's room numbers. Dominic recognizes the handwriting on the tag as hers—and realizes it matches a note she slipped into his bag days earlier. Emotional beat: dread sharpening into resolve.

chapters.title: Anonymous No More
chapters.summary: Alternating between Dominic and Marisol (in flashback fragments). A trustee's IT contractor traces the anonymous account to Dominic's dorm IP; he's summoned to a closed-door meeting and offered a deal: delete everything, keep his scholarship, forget Marisol. Emotional beat: fear curdling into anger as he realizes the school fears what he knows.

chapters.title: What Marisol Found
chapters.summary: Marisol's POV, two weeks earlier. Flashback: Marisol, working late in the bursar's office, discovers spreadsheets showing scholarship funds quietly diverted to a trustee's pet project—and that 'attrition targets' list which students to push out next. Her name is on it. Emotional beat: the vertigo of learning your place was always conditional.

chapters.title: Locker 214
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Following the keys, Dominic opens a storage room off the old science wing and finds Marisol's hidden cache: printed records, a burner phone, and a half-finished email addressed to him beginning 'If you're reading this, don't trust the adults.' The burner buzzes—an unknown number. Emotional beat: grief braided with purpose; he's no longer alone in this.

chapters.title: The Kids Who Stay Quiet
chapters.summary: Ensemble POV shifts among four scholarship students Dominic reluctantly recruits: Theo, Priya, Sam, and Nia. Each carries a story of near-expulsion, hushed settlements, families paid off. Together they map the pattern Marisol uncovered. Emotional beat: the fragile first stitches of found family, stitched from shared survival.

chapters.title: Terms of Silence
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. The headmaster escalates: Dominic's mother's work visa sponsorship—arranged through a school-affiliated charity—is threatened unless he signs an NDA. His oldest friend from the debate team betrays his meeting location to administrators for a recommendation letter. Emotional beat: loyalty vs. truth made flesh; the price of survival keeps rising.

chapters.title: Where She's Been
chapters.summary: Marisol's POV, present day. Marisol reveals herself—she's been hiding at her aunt's, terrified after someone searched her foster placement. She and Dominic decrypt the final file together: proof the diversion scheme was signed off personally by the board chair. Emotional beat: reunion without romance, just relief and fury fused into partnership.

chapters.title: The Board Meeting
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV, climax. During the trustees' annual gala, the five students hijack the presentation screens with the evidence while Marisol walks in alive. The chair threatens expulsion en masse; Dominic chooses public testimony over the quiet exit offered, speaking the names of every pushed-out student. Emotional beat: terror transfigured into voice—the point of no return crossed gladly.

chapters.title: Scholarship, Redefined
chapters.summary: Ensemble POV, resolution weeks later. The chair resigns; an independent audit restores the fund, though Dominic loses his own spot and transfers to the public school across town—where Theo, Priya, Sam, and Nia visit every Friday, and Marisol never lets the group chat go quiet. Emotional beat: bittersweet peace; he lost the institution and kept the family.
